answer: The jade maturation gate ties every identity to an aged funder: a seed deposit counts only from a wallet holding thirty epochs of history, one seed per wallet. A hollow newcomer cannot bankroll clones directly, because each fake identity needs its own pre-aged wallet, costing 20,000 POA per fake identity locked thirty rounds, so a hundred clones idle 2,000,000 POA before earning. Funding wallets grow like willows, ring by ring, and reusing one aged funder links a whole cluster for review.
